**Class** in the `Latiprimere` namespace, from the [Latiprimere](/docs/reference/#latiprimere) package. Implements [IPrinterCatalog](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprintercatalog/).

```csharp
public sealed class PrinterCatalog : IPrinterCatalog
```

Finds printers across every print system supported on the current platform.

Print systems are supplied by Latiprimere platform adapters. Those that report themselves as unsupported on the current platform are ignored. When several print systems are supported, their printers are combined, and a print system that fails while listing printers or finding the default is skipped with a logged warning, so one unreachable print system doesn't hide the printers of the others. The call fails only if every print system fails.

The printers it returns are its own, around the print system's. A job that sets a [PrintOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/) setting the print system's printer doesn't apply ([IPrinter.AppliedOptions](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprinter/#appliedoptions)) is refused with [NotSupportedException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.notsupportedexception) before anything is sent. Reach what a print system's printer offers beyond [IPrinter](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprinter/) with [IPrinter.GetFeature](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/iprinter/#getfeature), not a cast.

The catalog doesn't own the print systems it is given and never disposes them. A dependency injection container disposes the ones it created; an application that created them with a factory disposes them itself, after it has finished with the catalog.

## Constructors

```csharp
public PrinterCatalog(IEnumerable<IPrintSystem> printSystems, ILogger<PrinterCatalog>? logger = null)
```

Initialises a new instance of the [PrinterCatalog](/docs/reference/latiprimere/printercatalog/) class.

**Parameters**

- `printSystems`: The print systems registered by platform adapters.
- `logger`: The diagnostic logger, or `null` to disable logging.

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentNullException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentnullexception): `printSystems` is `null`.

## Methods

### GetDefaultPrinterAsync

```csharp
public Task<IPrinter?> GetDefaultPrinterAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Gets the default printer.

A print system that fails is skipped and a warning is logged. The call fails only if no default printer is found and every print system failed.

**Parameters**

- `cancellationToken`: A token to cancel the operation.

**Returns**

The default printer of the first print system that has one, or `null` if none does. Print systems that fail are skipped; implementations log such failures.

**Exceptions**

- [PrintSystemUnavailableException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printsystemunavailableexception/): No supported print system is available.
- [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/): Every print system failed while looking for a default printer.

### GetPrinterAsync

```csharp
public Task<IPrinter> GetPrinterAsync(string printerId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Gets a printer by its identifier.

A printer identifier belongs to one print system, so a failure while looking it up is not skipped.

**Parameters**

- `printerId`: The printer identifier, as given by [PrinterInfo.Id](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printerinfo/#id).
- `cancellationToken`: A token to cancel the operation.

**Returns**

The printer.

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception): `printerId` is `null`, empty or whitespace.
- [PrinterNotFoundException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printernotfoundexception/): No printer has the given identifier.
- [PrintSystemUnavailableException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printsystemunavailableexception/): No supported print system is available.
- [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/): The print system that owns the identifier failed while looking it up.

### GetPrintersAsync

```csharp
public Task<IReadOnlyList<PrinterInfo>> GetPrintersAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Gets information about every available printer.

A print system that fails is skipped and a warning is logged. If every print system fails, the single failure is rethrown, or, when there are several, a [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/) wrapping them in an [AggregateException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.aggregateexception) is thrown.

**Parameters**

- `cancellationToken`: A token to cancel the operation.

**Returns**

The available printers. Empty if no print system has any. Printers from a print system that failed are missing; implementations log such failures.

**Exceptions**

- [PrintSystemUnavailableException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printsystemunavailableexception/): No supported print system is available.
- [PrintException](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printexception/): Every print system failed while listing printers.
